notes.title: Pitchfork Kingdom is Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oVxy280hVc8;full][/previewyoutube]

It's finally time! Pitchfork Kingdom is available for purchase on Steam. Getting to this point took a lot of work but I'm glad we're here now. If you like beat-em-ups, platformers, and cute 2D graphics, maybe give Pitchfork Kingdom a try. I hope you enjoy!!

Adam

notes.title: Official Trailer Release
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3gahvh72Fg0;full][/previewyoutube]

The release of Pitchfork Kingdom is right around the corner and we are super excited about it! In the meantime, check out our new trailer to get hyped!
